name: The Honourable Trading Company
description: Merchant empire with its own navy. Main villain and final boss.

ai.style: Defensive merchant captains. Round shot, run when hurt, never board.

name: Royal Navy
description: Law of the sea. Hostile to pirates, but can be bribed or offer a pardon.

ai.style: Disciplined. Keeps up a turning rhythm, chains anyone who runs, grapes before boarding.

name: Pirate Brotherhood
description: Your side, as long as you keep the code. Runs the havens.

name: Rival pirates
description: Competition. Can be duelled, robbed or recruited.

ai.style: Reckless. Boards at a small edge, grapes first, sometimes fires heated shot.

name: Slavers
description: Always hostile. Free their captives for crew and Brotherhood favour.

ai.style: Cowards with cargo to protect. Run early, chain anyone trying to escape, never board.
